goal: Keep my Shopify store's inventory updated from my supplier's CSV and answer customer emails
capturedAt: TBD — each entry carries its own capture time, stamped when the capture item takes it
note: NOTHING IS CAPTURED YET. Every screenshot below is a surface the goal really touches: the store's own admin (products, inventory, orders) on the tenant host the merchant connected, the mailbox the customer email arrived in, and the storefront the sold-out cam now reads on. No drawn, mocked or synthetic image may go in this folder: an absent shot is skipped by the player (preload/has, demo/run.js:634-655) and the demo still plays, a fabricated one is a gate failure (P16 G3). Two kinds of source are flagged here: the ones behind a sign-in (the Shopify admin, Gmail) need an authenticated session, and two files — the supplier's CSV and the recurring sync — have no third-party page at all, because they are the goal's own workspace file and the platform's own schedule; those two are recorded with a null url and capture.mjs skips them rather than photographing a login page. WARNING for whoever runs assets/demo/capture.mjs: it keeps the file when a page answers with a sign-in wall, and gate P16 G3 counts any image on disk that is not in manifest.capture.captured as unaccounted (test/gates/p16.gates.mjs:249-255). Capture only the urls that answer as the real screen, and delete a wall shot rather than leave it counted. The five product photos under thumbs/ are the platform's own generated product shots ($0.04 each, fal.ai nano-banana-2), listed at the bottom.

voice.title: The sync note
voice.text: The supplier's file is read three times a day, at seven, at half past twelve, and at five. Nothing is written until the difference is on screen: what the store holds, what the warehouse says, and what will change. A row that already agrees is left alone, and a column the file has never had stops the run instead of renumbering the shelf.
